subject: Dedicated capacity discovery — isolation needs + initial SLA targets
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@careatlas.ai>, Dr. Luis Moreno <luis@careatlas.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity discovery — isolation needs + initial SLA targets

Hi Samira & Luis,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion. Below is a short recap from our side so we have alignment before we move into sizing and procurement. Please correct anything I got wrong.

Summary of pain points you expressed
- Model latency spikes during peak inference windows (batch of 300–400 concurrent user sessions causing 95th pct latency > 800ms).
- Regulatory requirement: PHI must never leave your VPC; audit logs and KMS integration are mandatory.
- Cost predictability: you need a capped monthly committed spend to justify procurement.

Goals you shared
- Deliver sub-300ms p95 for the most common 1k-token chat path (typical sequences 200–1k tokens).
- Reserved capacity with tenant isolation (single-tenant/gpu-silo) and ability to burst for training-like batch jobs outside peak hours.
- SLA: availability target ~99.9% for serving endpoints, and 4-hour incident response for Sev1.

Follow-ups / clarifying questions (we need answers to size a committed pool)
1) Peak concurrent inferences (qps or active sessions) — you mentioned ~350 concurrents but said this could grow 30% in Q4. Please confirm a 12-month target.
2) Typical & max sequence length distributions — we heard median ~450 tokens, 95th ~1,050 tokens. Confirm.
3) Will inference be single-model or do you plan multi-model routing (ensembles / reranking)? If multi-model, list top 3 models and preferred quantization.
4) Network topology & egress constraints — Evelyn is looping in our ops deck but please share your network diagram and KMS thumbprint.

Proposed next steps
- You: send the security + SLO doc and network diagram (Samira said she would send the SLO requirements).
- Us: Ben and I will run a preliminary sizing and cost estimate for a reserved GPU pool (isolation lanes + burst policy) and propose a canary plan.
- Schedule: can we do a 60-minute ops alignment call next week (Ben + Evelyn + CareAtlas infra team)? I added two suggested windows below.

Attachments: redwood_slo_template_v1.pdf (SLO template we use for Dedicated contracts)

Suggested meeting windows (PST):
- Thu Aug 5, 9:30–10:30 AM
- Fri Aug 6, 1:00–2:00 PM

If all looks right I will get Ben to produce the sizing doc and Evelyn to produce an isolation runbook draft for the shared call.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity discovery — isolation needs + initial SLA targets

Thanks Marissa — this is a solid recap and matches what we heard internally. A few quick clarifications and I attached the SLO requirements PDF you requested.

Clarifications
- Peak concurrency: confirmed 350 current; for sizing please assume 450 as the Q4 12-month forecast. We can re-evaluate after the initial canary.
- Sequence lengths: median ~420 tokens, 95th ~1,000 tokens. We included a small sample histogram in the attached doc.
- Model topology: primary model is atlas-med-7b (quantized int8), secondary reranker atlas-rank-220m. We want deterministic reranking for compliance reasons.
- Security: PHI cannot leave our VPC. We also require customer-managed KMS and syslog forwarding for audit.

Attachments included: careatlas_slo_requirements.pdf (contains sequence histograms, compliance checklist), network_diagram.png

Scheduling: Friday Aug 6, 1:00–2:00 PM works best for us — please send a calendar invite. Luis will join for the infra portion and our Head of Security (Elaine Park) may join for the KMS discussion.

One ask: can you include a preliminary cost envelope for a reserved pool with a 30% burst buffer in the sizing doc? That will help our procurement team quickly evaluate the committed spend.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of AI Platforms — CareAtlas
samira@careatlas.ai | +1 (617) 555-8873
